effects.printed_clause:
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: you can Special Summon 1 "Shining Brigade" monster from your hand. You cannot Special Summon monsters the turn you use this effect, except "Shining Brigade" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Shining Brigade - Heartbeat Division" once per turn. A "Shining Brigade" monster that has this card as material gains the following effect.
● Once per turn, when your opponent activates a monster effect: You can detach 1 material from this card; banish that monster.
effects.lua_implementation: On EVENT_BE_MATERIAL for a 0x7a34 Xyz, efop registers a holder Quick Effect with soft count; it removes one overlay as cost and banishes the activating monster if still related.

official_references.official_effect_text:
If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 "Zoodiac" monster in your GY, except "Zoodiac Ramram"; Special Summon it. An Xyz Monster whose original Type is Beast-Warrior [b]and[/b] has this card as material gains this effect.
● [b]When[/b] your opponent activates a Trap Card or effect that targets this card ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] detach 1 material from this card; [b]negate[/b] the activation.
